purpose: Same-device, same-frozen-source baseline/candidate UI response proxy; not AC-7 latency evidence

ordinary.title: 分析微信链路工具调用均需用户确认且安全审核Agent未被调用的原因并输出报告

method.interaction: CUA set the session search field, waited for the filtered row, clicked the first result at window coordinate [300,325], then polled full AX snapshots until the target body marker appeared and the other target marker was absent.
method.timer: performance.now immediately before the CUA click call through the first AX snapshot that contained the target body marker
limitations: The interval includes CUA click dispatch and AX snapshot transport/rendering overhead, roughly 1 second per sample; it is not a user click-to-paint latency.
The baseline and candidate were independently migrated COW copies of the same database seed (schema 107 and 117); they were not the same live database.
Baseline renders its legacy history path while candidate page size is bounded; the amount of message DOM work is not identical.
The large target is legacy-only, with zero History events and a blocked candidate ledger, so this does not measure a healthy canonical large session.
No hot-cache, damaged-cache, maintenance toggle/overlap, RSS, Long Task attribution, or canonical healthy history comparison is included.

conclusion: The large-session AX proxy distributions are nearly the same (baseline/candidate p95 1177.3/1175.1 ms), while candidate ordinary-session p95 is 1334 ms versus baseline 1098.2 ms and one candidate AX-ready sample took 3306.9 ms. Because the proxy is dominated by CUA/AX overhead and the candidate large target is unhealthy legacy-only, these numbers are diagnostic observations, not evidence that AC-7 passed or failed. P4-02, P4-03, and AC-7 remain open.
